This is the table's own house-rules chargen sheet - it replaces the standard rulebook creation process for this game. Follow it top to bottom.

  • Clan & Sect: Select your clan and political affiliation. See the Clan Population Limits & Restrictions and Restricted Paths & Rituals pages of this same entry before you commit to anything unusual.
  • Nature & Demeanor: Select your psychological archetypes.
  • Path: Select your moral code/Path of Enlightenment.
  • Generation: Starting generation must fall between 15th and 10th generation.
  • Attributes (Physical / Social / Mental): 7 / 5 / 3 distribution, in whichever order fits your concept.
  • Abilities: 11 points to distribute.
  • Disciplines: 5 dots to spend, maximum 3 dots in any single Discipline at start. See the Clan Discipline Swapping Rule below.
  • Backgrounds: 5 dots.
  • Virtues: 10 points to distribute across Instinct/Self-Control and Courage.
  • Willpower: Starts at 4. Your maximum permanent Willpower is capped by Generation (Laws of the Night Revised, p. 95) and is set automatically on the sheet from your Generation.
  • Blood Pool: Determined by starting Generation - use the Generation reference and the "Apply Generation" button on the character sheet's Main tab.
  • Freebies & Flaws: 12 base freebie points. Up to 7 additional points from Flaws. Optionally take 1 Derangement for +2 more freebie points, bringing the maximum possible pool to 21.

Clan Discipline Swapping Rule

Players may trade out any one of their clan's standard listed Disciplines for an alternative common Discipline from the list below. A Discipline gained this way is never Thaumaturgy or Vicissitude - those stay clan-exclusive.

Alternative Common Disciplines

  • Celerity
  • Potence
  • Fortitude
  • Auspex
  • Animalism
  • Presence
  • Obfuscate
  • Dominate

Caitiff & Pander

Caitiff and Pander characters may select any three Disciplines at creation, clan-specific or not.

These clans are capped in the game population, on top of any Storyteller-approval requirement noted:

  • True Brujah: Maximum of 1 allowed (Storyteller Approval Required)
  • Baali: Maximum of 1 allowed (Storyteller Approval Required)
  • Kiasyd: Maximum of 1 allowed (Storyteller Approval Required)
  • Cappadocian: Maximum of 1 allowed
  • Tremere: Maximum of 2 allowed at a given time

Check with your Storyteller before building a character of one of these clans - the slot may already be taken.

The following Thaumaturgy Paths require Storyteller approval before you may take them - each is flagged with a red "ST" badge on the character sheet wherever it appears (the Discipline itself and every Power under it), as a reminder:

  • Mastery of the Mortal Shell
  • Path of Father's Vengeance
  • Path of the Focused Mind
  • Path of the Levinbolt
  • Path of Technomancy

Bring your concept to your Storyteller before spending any dots here.
